about: Optional services beyond the initial Brand Concierge launch. The delivery hours are partner planning estimates.

lines.name: Launch a concierge in a second language
lines.scope: Extend an existing concierge to one additional supported language enabled in the sandbox. Reuse the approved knowledge source in a separate language-specific concierge. Review its starter prompts and answers with a local-language reviewer. The Typical scope covers 10 agreed questions, a corrections round and a signed test record.
lines.evidence: The knowledge source can be in another language, while responses are localized for visitors.

lines.name: Build product cards for a small catalog
lines.scope: Add a Product Catalog knowledge source for a small catalog outside Adobe Commerce. Map product names, images and destination links to the chosen spreadsheet schema. The Typical scope adds up to 40 supplied items and tests 10 product questions and their card links. Reuse any source mapping already completed during launch.
lines.evidence: Enables product deep links and product cards in concierge responses.

source.title: Create and manage knowledge sources for Brand Concierge | Adobe Brand Concierge

lines.name: Track concierge events in website analytics
lines.scope: Connect browser callbacks to one existing website analytics destination. The Typical scope maps 3 events, such as card clicks, completed responses and feedback submissions. Send only approved fields, exercise the events on a test page and check each arrives once. Reuse existing instrumentation if a Customer Journey Analytics connection already collects those events.
lines.evidence: listening to client-side events through callback functions

source.title: Developer and customization guide | Adobe Brand Concierge

lines.name: Customize the visitor chat experience
lines.scope: Apply an approved visual design beyond the standard launch settings to one concierge. The Typical scope customizes 3 chat components, such as the opening prompts, input bar and source citations. Review desktop and phone previews with the brand team, apply one round of changes and hand over the approved component settings.
lines.evidence: Visual styles and chat components display correctly on desktop and mobile views.

source.title: Manage a concierge | Adobe Brand Concierge

lines.name: Review concierge engagement each month
lines.scope: Use the included Brand Concierge dashboard for a monthly performance review. The Typical scope covers one live concierge, one comparison with the prior period and one team readout. Review conversation volume, unique users, sentiment and engagement, then agree on one improvement to test. Individual answer and source checks are scoped separately.
lines.evidence: Displays cards summarizing key metrics, including total conversations, unique users, sentiment trends, and engagement rate.

lines.name: Set up operating team roles and sandbox access
lines.scope: Extend access beyond the original launch team. Map operating teams to the sandboxes they manage and assign the Manage Brand Concierge permission. The Typical scope covers 2 teams across 2 sandboxes. Test permitted and restricted access with representative accounts and hand over the role and sandbox assignments.
lines.evidence: Select only the sandboxes appropriate for this role.

source.title: Create a role with Brand Concierge permission | Adobe Brand Concierge
